title: antirrhinum glaucum
intro: Antirrhinum glaucum, commonly known as the downy snapdragon or sea snapdragon, is a plant species belonging to the family Plantaginaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, with its roots and leaves used in traditional medicine to promote overall health and well-being. The health benefits of Antirrhinum glaucum include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce stress and alleviate respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and glycosides, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including sedative and expectorant effects.
